prose: Topher Gardner is the BioChar guy. He's also the dome guy, the esoteric energetics guy, the bamboo guy, and the guy who put together the Elementals Gathering, a conference of enlightening speakers, live music, and healthy minds at the Beartaria Festival Campgrounds in south-central MO.

In this episode we get into dome-architecture, the launch of Topher's new company, BlackGold Biochar, the deep connection between healthy soil and healthy humans, & how and why Biochar is the simplest and most effective method of soil improvement. We also discuss the role of balance of all elements and the yin & yang aspects of mind and body, and how these forces impact health.
